عششتن (form I)
# عَشَشْتُنَّ (ʕašaštunna) /ʕa.ʃaʃ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
# عُشِشْتُنَّ (ʕušištunna) /ʕu.ʃiʃ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
